cards.title: Service & Parts Have No AI-Indexable Entity
cards.body: No Service GBP profile and no Parts GBP profile exist — confirmed in the audit. GBP profiles are the primary structured entity that AI engines index for local businesses. Without them, those departments have no indexable presence for AI to reference. Note: whether a query like “Mitsubishi service Greece NY” on ChatGPT or Perplexity currently returns James Mitsubishi was not directly tested — but there is no GBP entity for AI to draw from.

cards.title: No Owner Posts on the Listing
cards.body: The Google listing shows no owner posts: no “From the owner” post and no local-posts list on the Overview, and none in the Search panel (checked October 20, 2026). AI engines that favor fresh, locally optimized content have nothing recent from this dealership to reference. Competitors publishing weekly are producing the content AI engines actively prioritize.
cards.pill: CLIKsearch — Weekly SEO/AEO/GEO Content Posts

cards.title: Directory Data Not Aligned
cards.body: The Mitsubishi dealer locator lists 866-906-1513 instead of the dealership’s (585) 563-2029, and the Yelp and Apple Maps listings are unclaimed. AI engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Bing Copilot are known to draw from third-party directory data; how much these entries affect AI answers was not tested.

cards.title: AEO/FAQ Content Strategy Absent
cards.body: The rendered homepage’s structured data holds the dealership entity and 15 Offer entries, with no FAQ or question-and-answer markup, and the Google listing shows no owner posts. The effect on answer engines is inferred, not tested.

cards.title: Active Knowledge Panel — Verified AI Foundation
cards.body: A claimed Google Business Profile with an active Knowledge Panel is the primary prerequisite for AI search visibility — confirmed in the audit. CLIKsearch builds on it: corrected schema, active 3-Pack profiles, and weekly content.

cards.title: First Organic Result for the Dealership Name
cards.body: A Google search for the dealership’s name in Greece, NY returns its own website as the first organic result (October 20, 2026). AI engines weight top-ranking pages as sources. CLIKsearch’s omni-social distribution across 6 platforms creates continuous cross-platform entity citations that multiply this authority signal for AI engine indexing.

cards.title: No Service GBP Profile
cards.body: No Service Google Business Profile listing was found in the audit. The website schema already describes a Service department, but no separate Service listing appears in Google. No “Departments:” line was seen on the Sales listing. Both views: the website’s schema already describes a Service department (audited October 20, 2026) — what is missing is the Google Business Profile listing for it.

cards.title: No Parts GBP Profile
cards.body: No Parts Google Business Profile listing was found in the audit; the website schema already describes a Parts department. Both views: the website’s schema already describes a Parts department (audited October 20, 2026) — what is missing is the Google Business Profile listing for it.

cards.title: No Owner Posts on the Listing
cards.body: No owner posts were visible on the Google listing on October 20, 2026: the Overview shows no “From the owner” post and no local-posts list, and the Search panel shows none.

cards.title: No Recent Owner Photos
cards.body: The newest owner photos are dated June 2019; none were added in the last 30 days. No Service or Parts photos were seen. The profile image shows the Mitsubishi logo.

cards.title: Yelp and Apple Maps Listings Are Unclaimed
cards.body: The Yelp listing is unclaimed and shows 2.0 stars from 8 reviews; its address and phone match. Apple Maps shows “Claim This Place” and lists the city as Rochester. Bing matches.

cards.title: Mitsubishi Dealer Locator Phone Mismatch
cards.body: The Mitsubishi dealer locator shows 866-906-1513 instead of the dealership’s (585) 563-2029.

cards.title: Website Schema Hours Differ from Google
cards.body: Google lists opening at 8:30 AM, while the website schema lists 9:00 AM for the same days — a 30-minute difference. Closing times match by day.

cards.title: Google Reviews Aren’t Shown on the Website
cards.body: The rendered dealership website did not show reviews; the audit found 1,599 Google reviews at 4.5 stars. Reviews can be displayed visibly to visitors — for example a Google reviews widget or testimonials — without any review markup in the structured data.

cards.title: areaServed Missing from the Dealership Entity; sameAs Links Only to Facebook
cards.body: Homepage sameAs lists Facebook only. The dealership’s own entity defines no areaServed; the only areaServed found is a small block on the Service page (no name or address) that lists Greece, Rochester and Irondequoit. The homepage has no hasMap property; a Google Maps link (map) appears on the Sales department entity only. The three department entities share the homepage URL and phone. Add hasMap and sameAs pointing to the Google Business Profile URL, and define areaServed on the dealership entity. (Effect on entity recognition and local rankings is inferred, not tested.)

cards.title: Strong Google Review Profile
cards.body: Google shows 4.5 stars from 1,599 reviews. The newest review was 3 days old, and the owner replied to 9 of the 10 newest. Facebook shows 72% recommend across 73 reviews; it does not display a star rating.

cards.title: Sales Listing Is Claimed; No Duplicate Found
cards.body: The Sales Google Business Profile is claimed. No duplicate Google listing was found in the audit searches.

why_card.title: Every Week Without Posts = Ranking Ground Lost
why_card.body: Google’s algorithm rewards consistent GBP activity. With no owner posts on the Sales listing — and no Service or Parts GBP listings found — competitors posting weekly OEM specials and service content are positioned to compound their Map Pack advantage every single week.

alert.impact_para2: With two revenue departments missing from Google, no owner posts on the listing, and no Google Business Profile link in the website’s sameAs schema
locked: Entity Authority: sameAs Links to Facebook Only — Knowledge Graph Signals Are Critically Thin

sameAs is how a site’s structured data points to a business’s other official profiles. This dealership’s lists Facebook only — the Google Business Profile isn’t among the linked profiles — so the site’s entity data is thinner than a fully built profile set.
Market Reach Undefined: No areaServed on the Dealership Entity — Surrounding Markets Not Stated

The dealership’s own structured data defines no areaServed property; only a small unnamed block on the Service page lists three cities. Greece, NY sits within a large metro market — every city left unstated is a missed chance to say where the dealership competes.
Website Schema Hours Differ from Google — Opening Time Off by 30 Minutes
Google lists opening at 8:30 AM while the website’s structured data says 9:00 AM for the same days — one more place where the dealership’s facts do not line up.
